scientific_conclusion.rationale: The reported 54.2% temporal rejection rate (167 / 308 GT-positive pairs) is NOT a reflection of impossible vehicle transitions. In reality, 100.0% (308 / 308) of the ground-truth cross-camera vehicle pairs are physically and chronologically feasible (time gaps 0.009s to 85.0s, median 4.45s). The 54.2% figure is an artifact of an asymmetric implementation defect in `temporal_feasibility`, which strictly requires `obs_a` to precede `obs_b` and immediately rejects `delta_t < 0` as `impossible_negative_time`. Because the evaluation adapter indexed pairs alphabetically (CAM_S01_C001 < CAM_S01_C002 < CAM_S01_C003), every vehicle traveling in the reverse direction (e.g. C003 -> C002, C002 -> C001, C003 -> C001) was evaluated with destination first and origin second, generating artificial negative elapsed time. Furthermore, CandidateGenerator sorts observations by raw video-relative timestamps rather than synchronized timestamps, causing 36 candidate pairs to also be inverted due to clock offsets.
